purpose: Prevent technical certification blocks from being misreported as sports rejection.

sports_axis.SPORTS_CANDIDATE: Audited NRFI_LEAN with ANALYSIS_COMPLETE + process PASS + Drive hash match.
sports_axis.NO_PLAY: Sports rejection for the NRFI product; preserve underlying YRFI_LEAN/NO_PLAY/NEUTRAL verdict.
sports_axis.WATCHLIST: Research incomplete or governing information not sufficient.
sports_axis.AUDIT_ONLY: Game not eligible for pregame execution because it had already started or equivalent temporal condition.

execution_axis.EXECUTABLE: A8 issued APOSTAR or SOLO_SI_CUOTA on verified market state.
execution_axis.TECHNICAL_BLOCK: Sports candidate exists but A4/A6/A7 authority chain prevents real-money execution.
execution_axis.PENDING: Sports candidate exists and execution chain has not yet resolved.
execution_axis.WATCHLIST: Research not complete enough to enter execution chain.
